properties.name: BFR66
properties.site-address: Greatness Cemetery frontage, Seal Road, Sevenoaks
properties.notes: The site is located adjacent to Sevenoaks urban confines. The existing access onto Seal Road could be utilised, providing that provision for through access to the cemetery is retained. Given the small scale nature of the site and the character of the area there are some concerns over amenity impacts which could be addressed through high quality design. Overall the site is considered able to accommodate development however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
